preserved_prior_failure.reason: Driver loop stopped at fifth durable click before sampling the fifth event; KeyError(native-controls). This is a test-driver bookkeeping failure, not evidence of a GUI stall. The original raw result remains unchanged.

accepted_observations: One stopped, owned GUI with one virtual profile and original main HWND. Five actual UI controls clicked and sampled: Select user 1, Configure user, Keyboard, Compatibility, Native controls.

At DPI 96 the owned GUI was resized to exactly 320x640 client pixels at the desktop right edge. A fresh owned renderer PNG after Native controls visibly showed the selected mode; frame progress and direct WM_NULL responsiveness were observed.
Product close-to-tray hid the original root; actual owned tray Open restored that same HWND visible and noniconic. A fresh product PNG, frame progress and direct WM_NULL response followed.

Owned minimization made the same root iconic/hidden; actual owned tray Open again restored the same HWND visible and noniconic. A fresh product PNG, frame progress and direct WM_NULL response followed.

Stopped idle progress reached frame 1416 after trigger frame 603, close restore 743 and minimize restore 1067; GUI stayed stopped throughout, with no routing Start/input, MCP or physical input calls and no backend DLL staged.
One actual owned tray Quit exited 0. The main and lifecycle HWNDs were gone; no forced cleanup, cleanup error or postflight integrity failure occurred.

viewed_images.note: Same pixels are expected for a static form; separate fresh file modification times, frame advancement and owned-window states establish temporal observations.

disposition: The current stopped GUI regression workflow passed in this reviewed build; the historical failure was not reproduced in this sample. Its cause and general reliability remain unproven. No full GUI-stall fix, broad UI parity, hardware behavior, RustDesk pointer behavior or MouseMux Ultra completion is claimed.
next: Proceed to the next substantive Ultra parity gap; retain historical P1 as an open separate issue rather than repeating this one diagnostic matrix without new evidence.
